name: Akram
source:
-In Harukanaru 1-
Head of the Oni tribe. He wants to get rid of all the foolish races like humans. He believes that he should rule the world. A cruel person who thinks of his underlings as nothing more than tools.
(Is only attainable in the PS2 and PSP versions.)

-In Harukanaru 2-
He's the first person the protagonist meets upon arriving in the parallel universe.
He gives advice to the protagonist, a man whose true intentions can't be seen whose words and deeds are filled with mystery.
